---
title: "Start bridge (@tuturuuu/start-bridge)"
description: "The frozen v0 contract for running Next App Router satellites on TanStack Start + Vite+ on Cloudflare, including the basePath and per-app session cookie rules."
---

`@tuturuuu/start-bridge` is the shared layer that lets a satellite's existing
App Router source run under TanStack Start, Vite+ and Void on a Cloudflare
Worker. It replaces the per-app `src/runtime` shim copies in Meet, Mail and
Calendar. The core (`route-match`, `base-path`, `cookie-scope`, `endpoints`,
`pages`, `api-forward`, `canary`, `request-context`) has no React, Start or
Vite imports; the `next/*`, `start/*`, `intl/*` and `vite` entries are the
framework adapters at the edge.

This page is the **v0 API freeze**. App lanes convert against these export
paths and signatures. Within v0, changes are additive only: a new optional
option, a new export, or a new subpath. Removing or changing a frozen
signature needs a new subpath and a coordinated migration.

## Export map

| Subpath | Exports | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `route-match` | `matchRoute`, `compareRoutePatterns`, `routeParam`, `routeSegments`, `RouteParams` | `[x]`, `[...x]` (one or more), `[[...x]]` (zero or more); malformed encoding throws `URIError` |
| `base-path` | `createBasePath`, `normalizeBasePath`, `retarget`, `BasePath`, `BasePathOptions` | The basePath contract below |
| `cookie-scope` | `DEFAULT_SCOPED_COOKIES`, `scopedCookieName`, `presentScopedCookies`, `scopeSetCookie`, `adoptLegacyCookie` | Used by `base-path`; exported for audits and tests |
| `request-context` | `withBridgeRequest`, `bridgeRequest`, `maybeBridgeRequest`, `createRequestLocal`, `headers`, `cookies`, `draftMode`, `connection`, `after`, `appendContextCookies` | One AsyncLocalStorage store for every alias |
| `endpoints` | `dispatchEndpoint`, `sortEndpoints`, `BridgeEndpoint`, `RouteModule`, `HTTP_METHODS` | Next route-handler semantics (HEAD→GET, OPTIONS 204, 405 with `Allow`, 400 on bad encoding) |
| `pages` | `matchPage`, `BridgePage` | Matches a generated page manifest |
| `api-forward` | `forwardToCentralApi`, `centralApiOrigin`, `HOP_BY_HOP_HEADERS` | Unowned `/api/*` to the central Web API |
| `canary` | `decideCohort`, `tagResponse`, `parseCanaryPercent`, `CANARY_PERCENT_VARIABLE`, `RUNTIME_HEADER`, `COHORT_COOKIE` | Interface frozen now, router behaviour in v0.2 |
| `next/headers`, `next/server`, `next/cache` | Next server APIs over the bridge request | `after()` needs a `waitUntil` binding |
| `next/navigation`, `next/link` | Router-mode navigation; `BridgeParamsContext` | Client navigation on the TanStack router |
| `next/navigation-document` | Document-mode `useRouter`/`NativeLink` | Full page loads (Apps gateway) |
| `next/image`, `next/dynamic`, `next/cloudflare-context` | Optimizer-free image, lazy component, `getCloudflareContext` | |
| `proxy-bridge` | `dispatchThroughProxy`, `defaultProxyMatches`, `toNextRequest`, `forwardedRequestInit` | Runs `proxy.ts` with Next's middleware protocol |
| `function-proxy` | `createFunctionProxy({ targetApp, prefixBase?, continueWith? })` | Guards the server-function base |
| `intl`, `intl/localized-navigation`, `intl/server` | `next-intl` on `use-intl`; en/vi localized links; `createIntlServer(messages)` | English unprefixed, Vietnamese under `/vi` |
| `start/handler` | `createBridgeHandler(options)` | The Worker `fetch` skeleton |
| `start/base-path` | `appBasePath`, `routerBasepath`, `withAppBase` | Build-time base for app code |
| `vite` | `startBridgePreset`, `startBridgeAliases`, `NEXT_SHIMS` | Plain config fragments; no plugin imports |
| `codegen` + bin `start-bridge-routes` | `planRegistries`, `classifyRouteFile`, renderers; CLI `generate`/`check` | Fails on any unregistered `route.*`/`page.*` |

## Worker handler

```ts
import start from '@tanstack/react-start/server-entry';
import { createBasePath } from '@tuturuuu/start-bridge/base-path';
import { createFunctionProxy } from '@tuturuuu/start-bridge/function-proxy';
import { appBasePath } from '@tuturuuu/start-bridge/start/base-path';
import { createBridgeHandler } from '@tuturuuu/start-bridge/start/handler';
import { proxy } from '../src/proxy';
import { endpoints } from '../src/runtime/api-registry.bridge.gen';

export default {
  fetch: createBridgeHandler<Env, ExecutionContext>({
    basePath: createBasePath({ app: 'meet', basePath: appBasePath() }),
    start,
    proxy,
    endpoints,
    functionBase: '/_serverFn',
    functionProxy: createFunctionProxy({ targetApp: 'meet' }),
    publicAssets,
    assets: (env) => env.ASSETS,
    centralApiOrigin: (env) => env.INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN ?? 'https://tuturuuu.com',
  }),
};
```

Order: base ownership (outside the base is 404), scoped-cookie presentation,
`/assets/*` and declared public files from `ASSETS` (base-stripped), then the
app's `proxy.ts`, the generated endpoint registry, unowned `/api/*` to the
central API (base-stripped), and finally Start at the browser-visible URL.
The response then gets Location rewriting and cookie scoping.

## Registries and the unregistered-route check

Each app declares `start-bridge.routes.json` at its root:

```json
{
  "appDir": "src/app",
  "stripSegments": { "[locale]": { "locale": "en" } },
  "api": { "out": "src/runtime/api-registry.bridge.gen.ts" },
  "pages": { "out": "src/runtime/page-registry.bridge.gen.ts" },
  "owned": { "api/build-info/route.ts": "src/native/api.server.ts" },
  "ignored": { "api/legacy/route.ts": "served by the central API" }
}
```

`bun packages/start-bridge/src/codegen/cli.ts generate apps/<app>` writes the
registries; `check` fails when a generated file is stale, a `route.*` or
`page.*` is neither generated, `owned` by an existing native file, nor
`ignored` with a reason, an `owned`/`ignored` entry names no file, two files
map to one pattern, or a parallel/intercepting route appears. Route groups are
dropped from patterns. The page manifest exports `PagePattern`; type the page
model as `satisfies Record<PagePattern, Loader>` so a new page fails
type-check until it is handled. `*.bridge.gen.ts` files are excluded from
Biome.

## basePath contract

An app runs at the origin root (`basePath: ''`, the default) or under
`tuturuuu.com/<app>` (`/meet`). Root mode is the identity everywhere. Under a
base:

| Concern | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Ownership | The Worker owns `/<app>` and `/<app>/*` only; `/meetings` is not `/meet` |
| Assets | Vite `base` is `/<app>/`; asset and public-file requests are fetched from `ASSETS` with the base stripped |
| Server functions | `serverFns.base` is `/<app>/_serverFn` (`startBridgePreset`) |
| Router | `basepath` is `/<app>` (`routerBasepath()` in `getRouter`) |
| Next middleware | `NextRequest` carries Next's `basePath`; `nextUrl.pathname` is app-relative and `nextUrl.clone()` redirects keep the base |
| Links and navigation | `next/link`, `useRouter().push/replace`, `redirect()` prefix path-absolute hrefs with `withAppBase` |
| Location headers | Path-relative `Location` not already under the base gains it. Absolute URLs are never rewritten, so `new URL('/login', request.url)` behaves as in Next (it leaves the app) |
| Central API | Unowned `/<app>/api/*` is forwarded as `/api/*` |
| Auth return URLs | Build them with `basePath.absoluteUrl(appPath, origin)` (or `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://tuturuuu.com/<app>`) so the central login returns into the app |

`tuturuuu.com/meet` is the Meet app root; product marketing moves to
`/products/<app>`.

## Per-app session cookies

Every satellite writes `tuturuuu_app_session` and
`tuturuuu_app_session_refresh` host-only at `Path=/`. On one origin they would
collide. **Decision: rename and path-scope.** Under a base the bridge writes
`tuturuuu_app_session__<app>` with `Path=/<app>` and presents it back to app
and auth code under the canonical name, so `@tuturuuu/auth` is unchanged.

- Path-scoping alone keeps one name; a stray `Path=/` cookie of that name is
  then also sent and the first-match lookup in `@tuturuuu/auth` depends on
  browser ordering.
- Per-app names alone at `Path=/` send every app's session JWTs on every
  request (about 25 apps × 2 cookies), risking header-size failures.
- Together, the name removes ambiguity and the path keeps each request to its
  own app's cookies. Clearing writes are scoped the same way, so logout in
  one app cannot clear another's session.

Other apps' scoped cookies and the unscoped canonical cookie are not
presented. Shared cookies (`NEXT_LOCALE`, Supabase auth, web app session)
pass through unchanged.

### Session migration

- **Same origin:** when no scoped cookie exists, an unscoped canonical cookie
  is presented as a fallback (auth still validates its audience) and the
  response re-issues it under the scoped name with the token's own `exp`.
  The unscoped cookie is never deleted; it may belong to the root app or
  another app. Disable with `legacyCookieFallback: false`.
- **Subdomain to path:** existing sessions are host-only on
  `<app>.tuturuuu.com` and cannot be copied to `tuturuuu.com`. A browser with
  a valid central (root) Supabase session gets a new app session through the
  existing `supabase-first` refresh on its first request. Users without a root
  session need a one-time cross-app token handoff from the legacy host; that
  auth change belongs to the cutover lane with the security reviewer and is
  not part of v0.

## Canary mode (v0.2 interface)

`decideCohort({ percent, cookie, force, draw })` returns
`{ cohort: 'native' | 'legacy', reason, persist, percent }`. The share comes
from `TUTURUUU_NATIVE_CANARY_PERCENT` (`0`–`100`; invalid or missing is `0`,
which is `legacy`). A valid sticky cookie `tuturuuu_runtime_cohort` keeps its
cohort while the canary is on; new browsers are drawn against the share.
`tagResponse` sets `x-tuturuuu-runtime`, appends `Vary: Cookie`, and persists
only new draws, scoped to the app path. Production publication stays held per
`tuturuuu.ci.ts`; the router that uses these is v0.2 work.

## Vite preset

```ts
const bridge = startBridgePreset({
  appRoot: import.meta.url,
  app: 'apps',
  navigation: 'document',
  shims: ['next/headers', 'next/server', 'next/navigation', 'next/link', 'next-intl'],
  serverOnlySpecifiers: ['@tuturuuu/satellite/auth'],
});
export default defineConfig(({ command }) => ({
  base: bridge.base,
  define: bridge.define,
  plugins: [voidPlugin(), tanstackStart(bridge.tanstackStart), react(), tailwindcss()],
  environments: { client: { define: bridge.clientDefine(command) } },
  resolve: { alias: bridge.alias },
}));
```

`basePath` defaults to `TUTURUUU_BASE_PATH` at build time. List `shims`
explicitly when converting an app whose current config aliases only some
`next/*` modules, so the bundle does not change.

## Verification

`packages/start-bridge` unit tests cover each core module and adapter at the
root and under `/meet`, plus the ported Meet proxy-bridge regressions. App
adoption still needs that app's exact-commit CI: unit, type-check, lint,
`vp build`, the sealed artifact and emitted-runtime acceptance where the app
has them.
